## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -2.59% | 1M: -6.69%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND and SPY (1W: +1.27% | 1M: +0.94%) ABOVE TREND vs TLT (1W: -2.38% | 1M: -4.41%) BELOW TREND show a risk-on tilt, while HYG (1W: -0.85% | 1M: -2.02%) & LQD (1W: -1.42% | 1M: -2.94%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND flag rising credit stress—hence a neutral, mixed read.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear easing: VXX (1W: -2.59% | 1M: -6.69%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND; credit stress rising: HYG (1W: -0.85% | 1M: -2.02%) & LQD (1W: -1.42% | 1M: -2.94%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND; stocks vs bonds skewed to equities: SPY (1W: +1.27% | 1M: +0.94%) ABOVE TREND vs TLT (1W: -2.38% | 1M: -4.41%) BELOW TREND.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-tight: UUP proxy showing dollar strength UUP (1W: +0.49% | 1M: +1.56%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND, while TLT (1W: -2.38% | 1M: -4.41%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND and the Yield Curve metric ↓ falling suggest incrementally tighter financial conditions.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Tech leading but narrow: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.64% | 1M: +7.47%) and SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.43% | 1M: +11.19%) showing strength, while defensives XLU BELOW TREND (1W: -3.16% | 1M: -8.53%) and XLRE BELOW TREND (1W: -1.46% | 1M: -7.05%) lag; style mixed / no clear leadership given weak breadth.

5. US vs Global?
US marginally stronger: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.27% | 1M: +0.94%) while EM EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.42% | 1M: +1.21%) holds modestly and China FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -1.05% | 1M: -4.47%) remains weak.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation alive in crypto/innovation: IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.37% | 1M: +7.00%) and ARKK ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.88% | 1M: +5.82%), but small caps IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -0.75% | 1M: -5.43%) show narrow breadth for risk-taking.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Industrial metals modestly supportive: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.94% | 1M: +1.37%), gold is soft with GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -1.93% | 1M: -6.62%), and oil exhibiting divergence—BNO CORRECTION (1W: -1.52% | 1M: +18.03%).

8. Energy Trend?
Mixed energy snapshot: XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -2.96% | 1M: -0.03%), Brent BNO CORRECTION (1W: -1.52% | 1M: +18.03%), while natural gas UNG ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.92% | 1M: +6.92%) is strong.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.64% | 1M: +7.47%) and SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.43% | 1M: +11.19%) show durable tech leadership; DIVERGENCE: Breadth 3/11 and HYG (1W: -0.85% | 1M: -2.02%) & LQD (1W: -1.42% | 1M: -2.94%) BELOW TREND highlight a narrow, credit-fragile advance.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor selective growth exposure such as XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.64% | 1M: +7.47%) and QQQ ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.30% | 1M: +4.77%) while reducing exposure to acute cyclical/defensive weakness in XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -2.96% | 1M: -0.03%) and XLU BELOW TREND (1W: -3.16% | 1M: -8.53%); monitor HYG/LQD for signs of credit spillover.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.64% | 1M: +7.47%) and SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.43% | 1M: +11.19%). BEARISH: XLU BELOW TREND (1W: -3.16% | 1M: -8.53%), XLRE BELOW TREND (1W: -1.46% | 1M: -7.05%), XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -2.96% | 1M: -0.03%).

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: UNG ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.92% | 1M: +6.92%) and watch BNO CORRECTION (1W: -1.52% | 1M: +18.03%). BEARISH: GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -1.93% | 1M: -6.62%).

13. Key Levels?
VXX around 20 for complacency (VXX 1W: -2.59% | 1M: -6.69% BELOW TREND); Credit Spread ~0.7544 (1W: +0.76% | 1M: +0.74%) as a stress trigger; XLK/XLF ratio 3.5790 (1W: +2.68% | 1M: +11.72%) to watch for tech dominance.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Tech showing relative strength—XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.64% | 1M: +7.47%) and SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.43% | 1M: +11.19%)—while credit measures HYG (1W: -0.85% | 1M: -2.02%) & LQD (1W: -1.42% | 1M: -2.94%) BELOW TREND are the key divergence to monitor.
